model.name: R19.85: Preview pinch gesture SCALES the content (shared RbPanZoom), not just pans.
model.description: Pinch on a preview SCALES the content (zoom in/out), not just pans. BUILT REALITY (measured on served v0.8.214, tester 76-audit): the original @400px IFRAME pinch-zoom path was RETIRED at R21.9/v0.6.74 (content-preview.ts:5). ALL preview surfaces (room file details via RoomView + trace browser rb-detail-view + rb-file-detail) now share ONE pan/zoom path — RbPanZoom (src/public/ts/trace/pan-zoom.ts), driven from a 75vh rb-preview-pane; fillPreviewPane() is the single mime->content builder reused by every caller (DRY). Pinch (2-finger) SCALES via CSS transform (clamp+apply); single-finger drag PANS at all scales (R40.29 pointer-unified, impl 58a7c149); wheel and double-tap-to-2x also zoom; no snap-back on release. Zoom bounds: MAX=8; non-grow MIN=0.25; grow-mode floor GROW_MIN=0.02 (R33.7.1 INV-Z1 — repeated zoom-out GROWS the working canvas, bounded by the host MAX-CANVAS-PX safety cap, not a hard 0.25 floor). The capability HOLDS; only the earlier req specifics ('iframe', clamp 0.25-4x) had drifted and are corrected here.
